title: Formally unramified scheme morphisms induce formally unramified stalk maps
statement: Let $g:U\to Y$ be a formally unramified morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] with formal unramifiedness as in [def-weil-pbc-formally-unramified-morphism], let $u\in U$, and put $R=\mathcal O_{Y,g(u)}$ and $B=\mathcal O_{U,u}$. The actual stalk homomorphism $g_u^\sharp:R\to B$ is formally unramified: for every commutative $R$-algebra $D$, every ideal $J\subset D$ with $J^2=0$, and every two $R$-algebra maps $s,t:B\to D$ whose composites with $D\to D/J$ agree, one has $s=t$. There is no local finite type, finite presentation, quasi-compactness, separation, or nonemptiness assumption.
